source.name: Football Shirt Culture: France 2026/27 Nike Home Kit
source.quote: The French Football Federation crest appears on the left chest in a metallic copper finish with two stars above, while the Nike Swoosh is placed on the right
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. FSC's launch description covers every mark on the shirt: the FFF crest with two stars, the Nike Swoosh, and inside the collar a printed detail reading 'Nos différences nous unissent'; the shirt 'is completed with white shorts and red socks'. No commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Nike's 2026/27 home shirt for the 2026 FIFA World Cup (Game Royal with a layered graphic pattern and white fold-over collar) carries only the FFF crest with two stars and the Nike Swoosh in metallic copper, plus 'Nos différences nous unissent' inside the collar, with white shorts and red socks (Football Shirt Culture's launch description).
